usage: icebath plugins [-h]
                       {install,search,browse,validate,update,adopt,trust-update-url,check-updates,check,remove,rm,uninstall,list,ls,enable,disable,capabilities,doctor,pack,show,info} ...

Install, update, remove, list, or validate native Icebath plugins and portable Agent Plugins v1
packages. Portable packages install disabled.

positional arguments:
  {install,search,browse,validate,update,adopt,trust-update-url,check-updates,check,remove,rm,uninstall,list,ls,enable,disable,capabilities,doctor,pack,show,info}
    install             Install a plugin from the curated catalog, a Git URL, or owner/repo
    search              Search the curated Icebath plugin catalog
    browse              List every curated plugin catalog entry
    validate            Validate a plugin directory for catalog admission (CI gate)
    update              Update an installed plugin, or with no name every plugin that has an
                        update
    adopt               Adopt a self-cloned plugin dir into provenance tracking
    trust-update-url    Confirm a changed plugin update_url into the saved tag
    check-updates (check)
                        Check whether installed plugins have updates (read-only)
    remove (rm, uninstall)
                        Remove an installed plugin
    list (ls)           List installed plugins
    enable              Enable a disabled plugin
    disable             Disable a plugin without removing it
    capabilities        Show declared vs granted capabilities per plugin
    doctor              Validate a plugin with the real runtime contracts
    pack                Declarative, shareable plugin sets (icebath-pack.yaml)
    show (info)         Show details for a single plugin (including emits/listens)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
